name: Teacher portfolio terracotta and oat scenes

style_rules.teacher_scene: Full terracotta #9E3D2D background, cream #FFF5E7 text and #F2DDC6 secondary text. Pale cream/clay contours. No split background panel or headline badge.
style_rules.student_scene: Full light oat #F5E5CD background, dark #38281F text and #64503E secondary text. Brown/rust contours. Switching identity changes the full ground, artwork and headline emphasis.
style_rules.accent: Coral #FF5738 is reserved for selected controls and primary actions with dark text. Warm oat reading areas, apricot #E4C5AF photographic spread, manifesto and footer remain.
style_rules.type: Locally packaged Manrope variable font. Body 17px. At 1440px desktop: first display line 187.2px, second 129.6px; statement 22px, study/metadata/actions 16px. Short laptop composition reduces display scale to preserve controls. At 390px: display approximately 70px and 43px, statement 17.5px, supporting text 14–15px, full-width actions at least48px high.
style_rules.mobile: Two-row name/role lockup, vertically stacked full-width actions, at least900px scene height. Compact contents navigation hides decorative section numbers on phones while retaining14px link labels.
style_rules.opening: Finite2.6second native name-mask and circular-iris sequence. 740ms name entrance, 110ms stagger, 1150ms iris delay and1050ms reveal. Apricot lining between paper and scene, a20px nominal rim and two thin rings. Contour opacity/focus settles without changing canvas bounds. Session replay, Skip, Escape, scroll/focus exit, resize cleanup and unsupported-clipping fade remain.
style_rules.photo_lens: Existing approved gallery photograph and native cursor retained. Terracotta #6D271EC7 and oat #F5E5CDC7 photo scrims keep foreground text readable. Decorative lens uses the existing atlas loop, pointer inertia and short phone-tap response. Pauses offscreen/hidden or at visitor request; disabled for reduced motion/data saving.
style_rules.rights: Original project CSS, native animations and generated contour geometry. No third-party motion code or media imported. Existing verified Manrope font and its complete SIL OFL notice retained. This snapshot contains reusable style data only, without personal content or media.
